children: a change in its corporate name to Silvia, with the new ticker symbol to be SVIA.
The changes are effective at market open on September 22.
Shares were 3.38% higher at $3.36 during pre-market trading.

The agentic finance firm said the new name aligns it with Silvia, its AI agent lab focused exclusively on finance, and the platform through which the company delivers its products to independent investors.
"As we continue to scale users, assets, and revenue, we want the name of the company to match the product," said CEO Anthony Pompliano.
The company's warrants, currently trading under BRRWW, will begin trading under SVIAWW at the same time.

title: ProCap Financial to change corporate name to Silvia, ticker to SVIA
